title: Word Ladder
description: A transformation sequence from word `beginWord` to `endWord` using a dictionary `wordList` changes one letter at a time. Return the number of words in the shortest transformation sequence, or 0.
input_format: First line contains `beginWord` and `endWord`. Second line contains `k` (words in list). Following `k` lines contain the words.

sample_tests.input:
hit cog
5
hot
dot
dog
lot
log
sample_tests.explanation: cog is not in wordList so impossible.

sample_tests.input:
hit cog
6
hot
dot
dog
lot
log
cog
sample_tests.explanation: hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog (5 words).

hidden_tests.input:
lead gold
4
load
goad
gold
head

hints: Model words as nodes in an unweighted graph where edges connect words differing by 1 character.
Use BFS to find the shortest path from beginWord to endWord.
Generate next words by replacing each character with 'a'-'z'.
